summary: PR-1951 adds a side-effect-free approvals_remaining helper to payments payments.py, plus unit tests. It does not alter approve, release, required_approvals or is_fully_approved. The ticket is approved and covers both components, the independent code review is on the head commit, and CI on head passes the full suite including the payments control tests. No security-sensitive component, protected path, emergency handling or exception is involved, so CHG-5, CHG-6, CHG-7 and EXC-1 do not apply.
